Ojos (AOM) y reflejos (MORPH)","metadata":{}},{"id":"eyes_reflex","cell_type":"code","source":"class AOMMembrane:\n    \"\"\"Constantes fieles a DynamicAOMMembrane (edge_observer).\"\"\"\n    def __init__(self, capacity=13):\n        self.cap = max(8, min(int(capacity), 64))\n        self.h: List[float] = []\n        self.state = 0  # 0 ESTABLE, 1 INESTABLE, 2 CONFLICTO\n\n    def push(self, score: float) -> int:\n        self.h.append(float(score))\n        self.h = self.h[-self.cap:]\n        sm = float(np.mean(self.h))\n        if self.state == 0:\n            if sm >= 0.42:\n                self.state = 1\n        elif self.state == 1:\n            if sm >= 0.68:\n                self.state = 2\n            elif sm < 0.35:\n                self.state = 0\n        else:\n            if sm < 0.58:\n                self.state = 1\n        return self.state\n\nREG = [\"ESTABLE\", \"INESTABLE\", \"CONFLICTO\"]\n\n\ndef score_rel(fq: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:\n    med = float(np.median(fq))\n    if med < 1e-9:\n        return np.zeros_like(fq, dtype=float)\n    r = fq / med\n    return np.clip(1.0 - 1.0 / np.maximum(r, 1e-6), 0.0, 1.0)\n\n\ndef make_adj(n, edges):\n    adj = [set() for _ in range(n)]\n    for u, v in edges:\n        adj[u].add(v)\n        adj[v].add(u)\n    return adj\n\n\ndef morph_minres(adj):\n    n = len(adj)\n    rd = [len(a) for a in adj]\n    alive = [True] * n\n    heap = [(rd[v], v) for v in range(n)]\n    heapq.heapify(heap)\n    S = []\n    while heap:\n        d, v = heapq.heappop(heap)\n        if not alive[v] or d != rd[v]:\n            continue\n        S.append(v)\n        alive[v] = False\n        for u in adj[v]:\n            if not alive[u]:\n                continue\n            alive[u] = False\n            for w in adj[u]:\n                if alive[w]:\n                    rd[w] -= 1\n                    heapq.heappush(heap, (rd[w], w))\n    return S\n\n\ndef improve_1_to_2(adj, S0):\n    S = set(S0)\n    changed = True\n    while changed:\n        changed = False\n        for u in list(S):\n            if u not in S:\n                continue\n            cand = [v for v in adj[u] if v not in S and len(adj[v] & S) == 1]\n            for i, v in enumerate(cand):\n                w = next((w for w in cand[i + 1:] if w not in adj[v]), None)\n                if w is not None:\n                    S.discard(u)\n                    S |= {v, w}\n                    changed = True\n                    break\n            if changed:\n                break\n    return sorted(S)\n\n\ndef morph_weighted(adj, w):\n    n = len(adj)\n    rd = [len(a) for a in adj]\n    alive = [True] * n\n    heap = [(-w[v] / (rd[v] + 1), v) for v in range(n)]\n    heapq.heapify(heap)\n    S = []\n    while heap:\n        key, v = heapq.heappop(heap)\n        if not alive[v] or abs(-key - w[v] / (rd[v] + 1)) > 1e-12:\n            continue\n        S.append(v)\n        alive[v] = False\n        for u in adj[v]:\n            if not alive[u]:\n                continue\n            alive[u] = False\n            for x in adj[u]:\n                if alive[x]:\n                    rd[x] -= 1\n                    heapq.heappush(heap, (-w[x] / (rd[x] + 1), x))\n    return S\n\n\ndef select_layout(flagged, health, zz, k, zz_thr=ZZ_THR):\n    \"\"\"Ruta rápida: señal → MORPH. Sin multi-sistema.\"\"\"\n    t0 = time.perf_counter()\n    n = len(flagged)\n    cand = [q for q in range(n) if not flagged[q]]\n    if len(cand) < k:\n        rest = sorted([q for q in range(n) if q not in cand], key=lambda q: -health[q])\n        cand += rest[: k - len(cand)]\n    idx = {q: i for i, q in enumerate(cand)}\n    edges = [(idx[a], idx[b]) for (a, b), z in zz.items()\n             if a in idx and b in idx and z >= zz_thr]\n    adj = make_adj(len(cand), edges)\n    w = [float(health[q]) for q in cand]\n    I = improve_1_to_2(adj, morph_weighted(adj, w))\n    chosen = [cand[i] for i in I]\n    chosen.sort(key=lambda q: -health[q])\n    chosen = chosen[:k]\n    if len(chosen) < k:\n        rest = [q for q in cand if q not in chosen]\n\n        def conf(q):\n            return sum(1 for (a, b), z in zz.items()\n                       if z >= zz_thr and ((a == q and b in chosen) or (b == q and a in chosen)))\n\n        while len(chosen) < k and rest:\n            rest.sort(key=lambda q: (conf(q), -health[q]))\n            chosen.append(rest.pop(0))\n    dt_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1e3\n    return sorted(chosen), dt_ms\n\n\nprint(\"AOM + MORPH listos.\")","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-10T03:57:12.123234Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-10T03:57:12.123561Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-10T03:57:12.152873Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-10T03:57:12.123536Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-10T03:57:12.152011Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"AOM + MORPH listos.\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":3},{"id":"s3","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## 3. Sensor de fricción (sonda sintética) y monitor AOM","metadata":{}},{"id":"sensor","cell_type":"code","source":"FULL = (1 << NQ) - 1\nEXP_A = sum(1 << q for q in range(0, NQ, 2))\nEXP_B = FULL ^ EXP_A\nT_RO, TAU_T1, TAU_RAM, SHOTS_PROBE = 1.5, 10.0, 10.0, 128\n\n_M1 = np.uint64(0x5555555555555555)\n_M2 = np.uint64(0x3333333333333333)\n_M4 = np.uint64(0x0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F)\n_H01 = np.uint64(0x0101010101010101)\n\n\ndef popcount64(x):\n    x = x - ((x >> np.uint64(1)) & _M1)\n    x = (x & _M2) + ((x >> np.uint64(2)) & _M2)\n    x = (x + (x >> np.uint64(4))) & _M4\n    return ((x * _H01) >> np.uint64(56)).astype(np.int64)\n\n\ndef probe_flip_probs(P):\n    T1, T2, p01, p10, e1 = P[\"T1\"], P[\"T2\"], P[\"p01\"], P[\"p10\"], P[\"e1\"]\n    p10e = np.clip(p10 + (1 - np.exp(-T_RO / (2 * T1))), 0, 1)\n    err1, err0 = p10e + e1, p01 + e1\n    bitsA = ((EXP_A >> np.arange(NQ)) & 1).astype(bool)\n    s = np.exp(-TAU_T1 / T1)\n    t1err = s * err1 + (1 - s) * (1 - p01)\n    p1 = 0.5 * (1 - np.exp(-TAU_RAM / T2))\n    ram = p1 * (1 - p10e) + (1 - p1) * p01 + 2 * e1\n    return dict(A=np.where(bitsA, err1, err0), B=np.where(bitsA, err0, err1), T1=t1err, RAM=ram)\n\n\nPROBES = dict(A=EXP_A, B=EXP_B, T1=FULL, RAM=0)\n\n\ndef run_probe(prob, expected, rng, shots=SHOTS_PROBE):\n    exp_bits = ((expected >> np.arange(NQ)) & 1).astype(bool)\n    meas = exp_bits[None, :] ^ (rng.random((shots, NQ)) < prob[None, :])\n    return (meas.astype(np.uint64) << np.arange(NQ, dtype=np.uint64)).sum(axis=1, dtype=np.uint64)\n\n\ndef swar_friction(words, expected, mask=FULL):\n    diff = (words ^ np.uint64(expected)) & np.uint64(mask)\n    return ((diff[:, None] >> np.arange(NQ, dtype=np.uint64)) & np.uint64(1)).mean(axis=0)\n\n\ndef observe_cycle(dev, t, rng):\n    probs = probe_flip_probs(dev.params(t))\n    F = np.zeros((NQ, 4))\n    for j, (name, exp) in enumerate(PROBES.items()):\n        w = run_probe(probs[name], exp, rng)\n        F[:, j] = swar_friction(w, exp)\n    return F.mean(axis=1)\n\n\ndef run_monitor(dev, seed):\n    \"\"\"Ojos: serie de fricción → score relativo → AOM por qubit.\"\"\"\n    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n    membranes = [AOMMembrane(13) for _ in range(NQ)]\n    smooth = np.zeros((dev.n_cycles, NQ))\n    states = np.zeros((dev.n_cycles, NQ), int)\n    friction = np.zeros((dev.n_cycles, NQ))\n    for t in range(dev.n_cycles):\n        fq = observe_cycle(dev, t, rng)\n        friction[t] = fq\n        s = score_rel(fq)\n        for q in range(NQ):\n            states[t, q] = membranes[q].push(s[q])\n            smooth[t, q] = float(np.mean(membranes[q].h)) if membranes[q].h else 0.0\n    return dict(friction=friction, smooth=smooth, states=states)\n\n\nprint(\"Sensor SWAR + monitor listos.\")","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-10T03:57:38.334452Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-10T03:57:38.334744Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-10T03:57:38.350355Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-10T03:57:38.334723Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-10T03:57:38.349440Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"Sensor Workload de fondo (ligero)\n\nCircuito sintético tipo Ramsey colectivo con error por T2, lectura y ZZ residual entre vecinos del layout. Representa **cualquier** trabajo abierto que ocupe el chip; no es un producto propio.","metadata":{}},{"id":"workload","cell_type":"code","source":"def workload_error(P, zz, layout, t_us=12.0, rng=None):\n    \"\"\"Error medio por qubit del trabajo de fondo sobre `layout`.\n    Combina decaimiento, lectura y desfase por ZZ coherente entre pares del conjunto.\"\"\"\n    if rng is None:\n        rng = np.random.default_rng(0)\n    S = list(layout)\n    n = len(S)\n    if n == 0:\n        return 1.0, {}\n    T2 = P[\"T2\"][S]\n    p01 = P[\"p01\"][S]\n    p10 = P[\"p10\"][S]\n    e1 = P[\"e1\"][S]\n    decay = 0.5 * (1.0 - np.exp(-t_us / np.maximum(T2, 1e-6)))\n    ro = 0.5 * (p01 + p10) + e1\n    zz_err = np.zeros(n)\n    for i, a in enumerate(S):\n        for j, b in enumerate(S):\n            if i >= j:\n                continue\n            z = zz.get(tuple(sorted((a, b))), 0.0)\n            phi = 2 * math.pi * z * 1e3 * t_us * 1e-6\n            zz_err[i] += 0.15 * abs(math.sin(phi))\n            zz_err[j] += 0.15 * abs(math.sin(phi))\n    # Ruido de disparo sintético\n    shot = rng.normal(0, 0.01, n)\n    err = np.clip(decay + ro + zz_err + shot, 0, 1)\n    detail = {\n        \"decay_mean\": float(decay.mean()),\n        \"ro_mean\": float(ro.mean()),\n        \"zz_mean\": float(zz_err.mean()),\n        \"n_qubits\": n,\n    }\n    return float(err.mean()), detail\n\n\ndef measure_zz_noisy(dev, rng):\n    return {e: max(0.0, z + float(rng.normal(0, 1.5))) for e, z in dev.zz.items()}\n\n\nprint(\"Workload ligero definido.\")","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-10T03:57:46.930660Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-10T03:57:46.930936Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-10T03:57:46.939845Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-10T03:57:46.930916Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-10T03:57:46.939037Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"Workload ligero definido.\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":5},{"id":"s5","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## 5. Multi-sistema (gobernanza retrospectiva)\n\nNo interviene en la ruta rápida. Solo registra hechos del ciclo cerrado y actualiza un hint de política.","metadata":{}},{"id":"gov","cell_type":"code","source":"ROLE_THRESHOLD = 0.20\n\n\ndef classify_role(effect_candidate: float, effect_latent: float, thr=ROLE_THRESHOLD) -> str:\n    if effect_candidate >= thr and effect_latent < thr:\n        return \"causa_directa\"\n    if effect_candidate < thr and effect_latent >= thr:\n        return \"indicador\"\n    if effect_candidate >= thr and effect_latent >= thr:\n        return \"mixto\"\n    return \"irrelevante\"\n\n\nclass GovernanceMemory:\n    def __init__(self):\n        self.history: List[dict] = []\n        self.role_counts = {\"causa_directa\": 0, \"indicador\": 0, \"mixto\": 0, \"irrelevante\": 0}\n        self.false_exclusion = 0\n\n    def record(self, cycle: dict) -> str:\n        role = classify_role(\n            cycle.get(\"effect_exclusion\", 0.0),\n            cycle.get(\"effect_latent\", 0.0),\n        )\n        cycle[\"role\"] = role\n        self.history.append(cycle)\n        self.role_counts[role] = self.role_counts.get(role, 0) + 1\n        improved = (cycle.get(\"err_A\", 1) - cycle.get(\"err_B\", 1)) >= 0.02\n        if role == \"indicador\" and not improved:\n            self.false_exclusion += 1\n        return role\n\n    def hint(self) -> dict:\n        n = max(len(self.history), 1)\n        rate = self.false_exclusion / n\n        return {\n            \"n\": len(self.history),\n            \"roles\": dict(self.role_counts),\n            \"false_exclusion_rate\": rate,\n            \"recommend\": (\n                \"prefer_reassign_over_aggressive_exclusion\"\n                if rate > 0.3\n                else \"current_policy_ok\"\n            ),\n        }\n\n\nprint(\"Gobernanza retrospectiva lista.\")","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-10T03:57:51.535741Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-10T03:57:51.536020Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-10T03:57:51.545258Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-10T03:57:51.536000Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-10T03:57:51.544088Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"Gobernanza retrospectiva lista.\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":6},{"id":"s6","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## 6.
